title: Desk: GPT-Live front over the ChatGPT login
summary: Built 2026-10-15 on release/0.38.0 (618a827a), pending George's QA. voice/realtime/live.rs places the call as the Codex app does: POST chatgpt.com/backend-api/codex/realtime/calls?intent=quicksilver&architecture=avas with the ChatGPT login's bearer + ChatGPT-Account-ID, openai-alpha quicksilver=v2, JSON {sdp, session{model gpt-live-1-codex, instructions, audio.output.voice, delegation{type client}}}; call id from Location; sideband wss://api.openai.com/v1/live/<call id>. The desk (not the phone) is the WebRTC peer (webrtc 0.20.3 + opus 0.4, as Codex pins): mic PCM 24k doubled to 48k, Opus 20 ms packets paced with silence fill; host candidates only. The sideband carries speech as 24 kHz PCM (session.output_audio.delta), transcripts, turns and delegation.created, so no Opus decode. delegation.created -> the bridge's send_to_teammate; a line to say -> session.context.append speakable (said in the model's own words, not verbatim); person's turn -> barge-in. Lines wait for session.started; create retried on 5xx/unreachable; sideband rejoined; ended call or failed peer drops the front to the pipeline. Free against the Voice budget. Voices: cove (default), juniper, maple, spruce, ember, vale, breeze, sol. Settings: Live calls > Model > OpenAI > GPT-Live (Included with your ChatGPT subscription). Proof: live/tests.rs unit tests + ignored live test (HOTLINE_TEST_CHATGPT_DIR, HOTLINE_TEST_ASK_WAV) passed 3/3 against the real service; make check green. Build needs cmake (docs/development.md). Not done: 60-minute session renewal (falls back to pipeline), attestation header (not required today).

title: Desk: a call's summary is the teammate's own words, and its session knows what was said
summary: Follow-up to task-75 (George's review 2026-10-16). task-75's summary is a mechanical log posted as an info notice: 'From the call: Asked: "…" Done: ran search_thread ×2; handed to the working session: "…"'. Three problems: (1) it omits what the front answered, so it is not a summary of the conversation; (2) it names internals (tool names, 'working session') and reads as the system, not the teammate, breaking the one-teammate goal of ADR 0005; (3) info notices never enter the teammate's history (session/chapters.rs only carries error notices), so after a call the working session does not know what was said, and a typed follow-up starts cold. Do: write the summary in the teammate's first person from the call's transcript (what was asked, what the front answered, what it looked up, what is still being worked on, what is left open), in plain prose with no tool names; post it as an agent message from the teammate tagged as from the call; and put it in the teammate's history so its next turn carries on from the call (the person's words and the front's answers, scrubbed and budgeted as front_prompt does). Decide and record (ADR 0005 open question) whether the front writes it (cheap, live) or the teammate's session is handed the transcript to write it; default to the front's words. post_to_chat posts as the teammate too. Harness: after a call that answered a question from search_thread, the DM shows one first-person summary with the answer and no tool name, and a typed follow-up turn's history includes the call.

title: Providers: Live calls and Images can be turned Off
summary: George 2026-10-16: some people will not want live calls or image generation at all. Settings › Providers › Use for gets an Off choice on both pickers, last in each list and never the default (a new or unset desk keeps today's behaviour). Live calls Off: the desk offers no calls, to the desk or a teammate: voice.status reports calls unavailable with a reason ('Calls are off in Settings'), so the window's composer call key and dock desk key are not drawn (no fake UI) and the phone draws no call key either (its capability check already follows voice.status). This is distinct from Legacy voice, which still calls. Images Off: no teammate is offered generate_image (Hotline Agent's tool list and the MCP tool both refuse with 'Image generation is off in Settings'), avatar generation for a new teammate is offered without a picture, and the Images picker shows Off. Stored in the room's settings beside the existing picks (voice.front provider 'off'? or a separate enabled flag: pick the shape that an older desk reads as the default, and record it in docs/voice.md and the images doc). Mirror on the phone: hotline-mobile Voice & images lists Off in both choice pages (separate mobile task once the desk ships). Harness: with Live calls Off, voice.call_start is refused and voice.status says why; with Images Off, generate_image is not in a teammate's tools.
